collection.title: Rolls Royce Ghost 2014 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Rolls Royce Ghost 2014 - 2020 model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
